rows.description: Open-source, self-hosted newsletter, email marketing and transactional email platform. Visual MJML editor, Liquid templating, 7 sending providers.
Django email backends and webhooks for Amazon SES, Brevo, MailerSend, Mailgun, Mailjet, Mailtrap, Postmark, Postal, Resend, Scaleway TEM, SendGrid, SparkPost, Unisender Go and more
Newsletters where you pay for the emails you send, not for dormant subscribers, at a fraction of the price of beehiiv and the like. Open source: self-host it, or use mailcheap.ai.
